task_title: GAP-007: dispatcher decomposes Helix's own spec files
task_criteria: DecomposeSpec (pkg/dispatcher/decomposer.go) accepts an H1 heading matching "^# Helix Feature" (case-insensitive) as a section marker — each feature H1 starts one Task with priority by section ordering.
Existing ## PHASE / ## Feature H2 detection is unchanged and its tests (reads phase sections, reads feature sections) still pass.
A spec with only "# Helix Feature N — Title" H1 plus non-keyword H2 sections (e.g. ## 1. Mission) decomposes into exactly 1 task whose Description is the H1 text and Priority is 1.
A spec with no Phase/Feature H2 sections and no "# Helix Feature" H1 still returns ErrDecomposeFailed (no-section error path preserved).
Live CLI PASS: ./helix dispatcher list-tasks --spec specs/agent-identity.md prints a task list and exits 0 (not the decompose-failed error).
